subject: planner: fix column evaluator can not detect input's column-ref and thus swapping and destroying later column ref projection logic (#53794)
summary: Reviewed the columnEvaluator change that detects in-chunk column references (pointer-equal columns) and merges inputIdx->outputIdx mappings to avoid SwapColumn leftmost-ref behavior breaking subsequent projections. Verified concurrency context: ProjectionExec parallel workers share one EvaluatorSuite; the new atomic.Pointer initialization prevents races, and the merge is computed once based on stable input chunk ref structure. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL-semantics, or concurrency issues found in the touched expression logic.
